submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively when the current token completes or continues a fixed, conventionalized multi-word formula: an institutionalized compound (central bank), a legal/news/textbook cliche (court/jury ruled that, According to the report, are often called), a code or markup idiom (import numpy as np, ><h), or a stereotyped time/number/list expression (9 a.m., Apollo 11, Tokyo, Berlin). Strength scales with how stereotyped the exact wording is (full narrative context boosts it further); it sits at a weak ~0.34 baseline on sentence-initial tokens and near zero elsewhere. Swapping one word of the formula for a near-synonym collapses the peak, while changing words after the peak leaves it unchanged.
